import pandas as pd
files=['airlines/DL.csv','airlines/UA.csv']
frames=[]
for f in files:
 d=pd.read_csv(f)
 d['date']=pd.to_datetime(d['date'])
 d=d[d['date'].dt.month.isin([1,2]) & d['date'].dt.year.eq(2025)].copy()
 d['route']=d.apply(lambda r:'-'.join(sorted([str(r['origin']),str(r['dest'])])),axis=1)
 frames.append(d)
all_df=pd.concat(frames,ignore_index=True)
counts=all_df['route'].value_counts().sort_index()
print('total',len(all_df),'routes',len(counts))
print(counts.to_string())
print('carrier totals',[(f,len(pd.read_csv(f))) for f in files])
